title: § 5.7 Reports to the Secretary of Labor.

§ 5.7 Reports to the Secretary of Labor.
§ 5.7 Reports to the Secretary of Labor.
(a) 
Enforcement reports.
(2) Where underpayments by a contractor or subcontractor total $1,000 or more, or where there is reason to believe that the contractor or subcontractor has disregarded its obligations to workers or subcontractors, the Federal agency will furnish within 60 days after completion of its investigation, a detailed enforcement report to the Administrator.

(b) 
Semi-annual enforcement reports.
(c) 
Additional information.
(d) 
Contract termination.
